name: PEG-17 Glyceryl Palmitate
description: PEG-17 Glyceryl Palmitate (CAS 70852-71-0 ), also known as Polyethylene Glycol Glyceryl Palmitate, is a PEG-modified glyceryl ester derived from palmitic acid. It is used as a nonionic emulsifier and wetting agent across personal care and cleaning formulations. This versatile ingredient bridges oil and water phases while supporting moisture retention in finished products. In rinse-off and leave-on cosmetics, including lotions, creams, and hair conditioners, it stabilizes emulsions effectively. It improves skin feel without leaving heavy residue, making it ideal for high-end formulations. Formulators incorporate it into cleansing systems such as body washes and facial cleansers to enhance wetting and solubilize oils. In home care and industrial cleaning products, it supports soil removal by improving surface wetting. It is particularly effective at dispersing oily soils across hard surfaces in various commercial and residential environments. The compound also functions as a humectant carrier in moisturizing formulations. By helping retain water in the skin matrix, it supports hydration performance and enhances the overall efficacy of topical skincare products. PEG-17 Glyceryl Palmitate is typically supplied as a paste or waxy solid, depending on grade and processing conditions. It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications suited for personal care applications and technical-grade forms. Packaging options generally include drums and intermediate bulk containers for commercial quantities.
